runs.name: Charcuterie
runs.donorNote: Grape Pie bx × Cheesy D (UK Cheese × Chem D). One male kept out of seven: the strongest stem rub and vigour, magenta and purple striping, pink-purple sacs. Grape Pie bx dominates the progeny — grape drink, fruit leather, compact and resinous.
runs.dates: Flip Jul 4 2024 · male in Jul 11 · pollen ~Jul 22 · male out Aug 2 · packed Sep 30.
runs.story: The first attempt. Nine crosses off one male, run in a small tent.

runs.name: Lime Bubble
runs.donorNote: Black Lime Reserve "Jodrey" cut × '04 Bog Sour Bubble BxC-2 F2. Two males used together: a lanky Black Lime leaner with a sour rub, and a compact Sour Bubble leaner, incense and greasy.
runs.dates: Flip ~Jan 12 · males in Feb 2 · pollen Feb 5–16 · chopped Mar 24 · packed Apr 15.
runs.story: The biggest roster so far and produced three of the flagships.

runs.name: Gushy Kush
runs.donorNote: An untested F1 out of Soiltech's swamp: Tiger Mint Kush F2 × Pure Michigan F3 on the mother side, Trufflez F2 as the father. Three males used.
runs.dates: Seeds wet Feb 9–15 · flip Apr 1 · pollen late Apr–May · chopped ~Jun 19 · box sets Jun 27.
runs.story: A collaboration run: the mothers came from other OverGrow growers, so the seeds went back out to the people who sent the cuts.

runs.name: Side chucks
runs.donor: Sugarplum Skunk ♂ and Pure Pink Gushy ♂
runs.donorNote: Two males saved out of earlier runs and put to work on the side — the first crosses made entirely from SpaceCraft stock.
runs.dates: Males found summer 2025 · Lemon Tree Kushy seeds Sep 2025.
runs.story: Not a tent run: single plants pollinated as the chance came up. Both results went onto the 2026 mother roster.

runs.name: Pine line
runs.donorNote: Two F1 males from the unreleased mutant Communion × Charcuterie line — spade-shaped overlapping leaves, one of them resinous with the earthy sweet pine that names the line.
runs.dates: Flip late Jan · pollen Feb · males out Feb 22 · dry by Apr 2 · testers in flower Sep 2026.
runs.story: Flagship Project #1 put to work. A pine line F2 was made on two stand-in females at the same time to hunt the mutant male again.

runs.name: Outdoor
runs.donorNote: Pollen off a Pinecake male — a second-generation SpaceCraft plant doing the pollinating, out of Blueberry Cupcake × pine line.
runs.story: The first run done outdoors, and the biggest: ten mothers under one male.
